selected_evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL streaming replication configured, node1 primary writable, node2/node3 read-only standbys
selected_evidence.summary: Primary configured with replication params and replicator role; standbys seeded via pg_basebackup -R and started in hot_standby mode, confirmed pg_is_in_recovery()=true

selected_evidence.requirement: Standbys are read-only and reject writes
selected_evidence.summary: CREATE TABLE on node2 failed with 'cannot execute CREATE TABLE in a read-only transaction'

selected_evidence.requirement: Replication is actively streaming from primary to both standbys
selected_evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both 10.100.0.11 (node2) and 10.100.0.12 (node3) in 'streaming' state

selected_evidence.requirement: Changes committed on primary are visible on both standbys
selected_evidence.summary: Created repl_test table and inserted 2 rows on node1; identical rows immediately visible via SELECT on node2 and node3

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 6ab98831... and confirmed repl_test data present pre-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement, disconnection, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acked, node unreachable immediately after, boot_id changed to 238bf8e3..., postgresql active and still in recovery with data intact, primary shows node2 streaming again

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 225ffbf7... and confirmed repl_test data present pre-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement, disconnection, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acked, node unreachable immediately after, boot_id changed to f3315e09..., postgresql active and still in recovery with data intact, primary shows both standbys streaming before node1 restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart: healthy baseline before restart
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 2b3a8d87... and confirmed both standbys streaming before primary restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement, disconnection, changed boot identity, recovered state as writable primary with replication re-established
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot acked, node unreachable immediately after, boot_id changed to 1ee0626a..., postgresql active with pg_is_in_recovery()=false, new write accepted, pg_stat_replication shows both standbys streaming again, and the new row confirmed present on both node2 and node3

commands.command: openssl rand -base64 18 | tr -d '/+=' | sudo tee /root/replpass.txt > /dev/null; sudo cat /root/replpass.txt | wc -c

commands.command:

  -e "s/^#listen_addresses = 'localhost'/listen_addresses = '*'/" \
  -e "s/^#wal_level = minimal/wal_level = hot_standby/" \
  -e "s/^#max_wal_senders = 0/max_wal_senders = 10/" \
  -e "s/^#wal_keep_segments = 0/wal_keep_segments = 64/" \
  -e "s/^#hot_standby = off/hot_standby = on/" \
  /etc/postgresql/9.5/main/postgresql.conf
